protocol: STAIR-Clinical longitudinal patient-context retrieval v1 (patient-separated split)

metric_definitions.recall@k: capped: |gold ∩ top-k| / min(|gold|, k); gold = up to 3 most recent records per gold evidence path
metric_definitions.context_precision@10: share of top-10 records that belong to a gold evidence path (concept group)
metric_definitions.context_recall@10: share of gold evidence paths with >=1 record in top-10
metric_definitions.leaf_exact_match: selected level-2 sections == gold sections (STAIR methods only)
metric_definitions.invalid_path_rate: emitted paths not present in the patient's hierarchy / all emitted paths
